subject.title: [Bug]: Managed node install can retain invalid Gateway connection settings

question: Should maintainers proceed with the linked core PR for this protected managed-node credential/TLS fix, split it, or defer it?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and the fix changes credential persistence, systemd env-file cleanup, and TLS pinning behavior while the linked PR still has review follow-up.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR after its blocker is fixed
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103093 as the canonical fix path once its remaining review finding is resolved and validation is acceptable.

options.title: Split the security-sensitive surfaces
options.body: Separate password/env-file handling from TLS retargeting if maintainers want smaller review units for credential and TLS changes.

options.title: Defer protected work
options.body: Leave this issue assigned for manual scheduling without queuing a new ClawSweeper repair job.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR after its blocker is fixed
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103093 as the canonical fix path once its remaining review finding is resolved and validation is acceptable.
